intentComment: Story 060 — yield-strategy swap migration (June 12 2026): replace buggy ERC4626YieldStrategy DOLA/USDC instances on StableStaker via two-leg bounce through a temp staker
legIntent: Step 4 (leg 2): migrator2.initiateMigration(DOLA/USDC) on the temp staker, then chunked migrator2.migrate(...) to move all DOLA and USDC stakers back into the original StableStaker, which is now wired (by ResetAndRewire, step 3) to the fixed V2 yield strategies.

broadcast.mechanism: vm.startBroadcast() — Ledger hardware wallet signs as owner

jsChain.note: Neither leg2 variant runs any node script. Required inputs are produced out-of-band by the sibling input-gatherer `migrate:ys-swap-gather-leg2` (node scripts/gather-migration-inputs.js --leg 2 → script/migration-inputs/leg2-stakers.json) and by the suite deploy step `migrate:ys-swap-deploy` (DeployTempStableStakerAndMigrators broadcast → script/migration-inputs/ys-swap-deployments.json). Unlike migrate:ys-swap-reset and migrate:ss-execute-mainnet, leg2 has no backup-mainnet-addresses.js / patch-mainnet-addresses-*.js wrapper — it does not touch mainnet-addresses files.
